classification.difficultyReason: One cosine-rule angle from three sides.

content.prompt: A triangular sail has edges of length $5.2\text{ m}$, $4.1\text{ m}$ and $3.0\text{ m}$. Calculate the size of the angle between the $5.2\text{ m}$ and $4.1\text{ m}$ edges, correct to the nearest $0.1$ degree.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the $5.2\text{ m}$ and $4.1\text{ m}$ edges.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{5.2^2+4.1^2-3.0^2}{2(5.2)(4.1)}\\\cos\theta&=\frac{34.85}{42.64}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{34.85}{42.64}\right)\\\theta&\approx35.2^\circ\end{align*}$$
